topTools.name: list_mcp_tools
topTools.purpose: DISCOVERY TOOL: Get a comprehensive list of all available MCP tools in this server with their descriptions, parameters, and capabilities

topTools.name: get_current_customer_info
topTools.purpose: Retrieve basic account context including customerName and customerPlan

topTools.name: get_assets
topTools.purpose: Retrieve asset records with comprehensive details including assetID, name, location, parent/child relationships, operational hours, timestamps (startedOn, lastEdited), and optional geoLocation coordinates

topTools.name: get_asset_fields
topTools.purpose: Retrieve custom field definitions and values for specific assets

topTools.name: get_asset_field_history
topTools.purpose: Retrieve custom field change history across assets

topTools.name: get_asset_parts
topTools.purpose: Retrieve parts linked to specific assets, showing the relationship between inventory items and equipment

topTools.name: get_suggested_asset_fields
topTools.purpose: Retrieve organization-wide suggested (template) field definitions for assets

topTools.name: resolve_asset_context
topTools.purpose: Efficiently resolve multiple asset IDs to human-readable context including assetName, locationName, and parent relationships

topTools.name: get_assets_by_maintenance_cost
topTools.purpose: Rank assets by total maintenance spend (parts + labor)

topTools.name: get_tasks
topTools.purpose: Retrieve work order/task records with comprehensive details including taskID, name, assigned user/team, location, asset linkage, type (reactive/preventive/template), priority, status (0=incomplete, 1=complete), timestamps (createdDate, startDate, due, dateCompleted, lastEdited), custom meta fields (meta1-3), custom tags, description, estimatedTime, downtime, completion notes, work request fields (requestor info, custom fields/dropdowns), statusID for custom statuses, and geoLocation

topTools.name: get_open_tasks_count
topTools.purpose: Quickly retrieve the count of incomplete (open) tasks without fetching full task records

topTools.name: get_task_comments
topTools.purpose: Retrieve all comments (conversation history) for a specific task
